g.text: Settings | Global preferences, appearance, storage, and app behavior | Local
State: Draft — save with s | Changes affect global Console fallbacks after save.
Global defaults for new and inherited conversations. Current-conversation
overrides remain in the Console's Context & memory view.
Visual and Hybrid apply only to vision-capable sessions; unsupported models
safely use Text summary without overwriting this default.
Summary response max applies only to Text summary and Hybrid.
Text summary and Hybrid make one extra model call and store generated memory with
provenance. Visual pages are rendered on-device for one request and never
persisted. Original transcript messages remain stored. Off disables optional
compaction only—mandatory provider safety trimming still applies.
Used when no provider+model profile or active Console session overrides them.
Used for your speaker label. Character chats also use it for trusted {{user}}
Esc, s save category | Esc, r revert category | F1 help · F6 next pane · Ctrl+P palette · Ctrl+Q quit
